content.text: Nicknames are epithets defined in files in the common/nicknames folder.
Any nickname defined in one of these files can be added using the give_nickname command . They can also be granted at random based on conditions defined on the nicknames.

rows: Optional. The conditions a character must fulfill to be eligible to receive the nickname randomly. If missing, nickname can only be obtained with the give_nickname command.
Optional. The odds of an eligible character receiving the given nickname (presumably in percent per year). If missing, nickname can only be obtained with the give_nickname command.

content.text: Nicknames take their localization from a key with the same name as the nickname. For example, the nickname nick_the_swift would look for the localization key also called nick_the_swift . Nicknames typically begin with nick_ , but this is not enforced. For nicknames which use localization commands, those commands are only evaluated when the nickname is handed out - a nickname will not change after it's been obtained.
